sections.body:
### What comes out
- Vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar and other
- 4 to 6 stems per track
- GPU acceleration, plus a CPU-only mode that works but is slower

sections.headline: Queue the whole album.
sections.lede: Batch processing with an unlimited queue. Load the tracks and let it run overnight.
sections.body: Each stem gets a waveform, transport and its own controls as soon as the split finishes. In the Windows app you can paste a YouTube URL to import the audio locally, then start the split yourself — it does not auto-split. Pro can import MP3 128/192/320, WAV, FLAC, video up to 4K, and playlists of up to 25 videos. The free demo imports MP3 192 (the first video from a playlist). Turn separated vocals into text with **Whisper transcription** for lyrics, captions and timestamped notes.

sections.headline: Shape every stem in the FX rack.
sections.lede: 14 FX modules per stem, built in. Go from split to finished stems in one app.
sections.body: EQ, compressor, reverb, delay, saturation, stereo widener, pitch shifter and more, applied to each stem on its own. Ships with 15 FX presets. Full FX apply is Pro; the free demo gives a 5-second preview.

sections.body:
### System requirements
- Windows 10 or later (macOS and Linux coming soon)
- 8 GB RAM, or 16 GB for large batches
- NVIDIA GPU with 4 GB+ VRAM for the fastest processing; CPU-only works but is slower

### Installing
Windows may show a SmartScreen notice for new independent software: choose **More info → Run anyway**, and check the SHA-256 checksum published with the installer.

### 30-day money-back guarantee
If Liminal Pro isn't right for you, email within 30 days of purchase with the address you used at checkout for a full refund.
